lines.en: I headbutt plants!
My head's tough!
I munch leaves and grass.

lines.zh: 我沿灌木线小跑，挨个闻过去。
lines.en: I trot the hedge line, sniffing it end to end.

lines.zh: 我这颗厚头顶，撞一下你就退。
lines.en: One butt of this thick skull sends you back.
More plants, please.
My head's tougher than stone!
Two bites of this fern first.
My skull's thick!
My short legs churn fast.
I smell new shoots and run for them.
I push the ferns apart to find food.
I circle the bounds of my territory.
I trot along over fallen leaves.
Enjoy the sun.
My skull's sturdy.
I'm eating here.

lines.zh: 我的头顶，撞石头都不怕。
lines.en: My skull can butt stone without fear.
I'm happy.
My head protects me.
My skin's thick.
It's calm here.

lines.zh: 我低头嚼草，只把眼角留给你。
lines.en: I lower my head to graze, keeping one eye on you.
I rub the top of my head on a trunk.
I chew my grass and ruminate slowly.
I tilt my head to the sounds in the trees.
I scrape a small pit in the warm soil.
My little tail sways gently.
What if you get close?
You won't hurt me.
Don't fear me.

lines.zh: 我这颗硬头，撞树都嫌浪费。
lines.en: This hard skull is wasted on trees.
Get closer.
You're safe.
I won't attack you.
It's safe to approach.
I look up at you, still chewing.
I lower my head as if to butt.
I circle you once, sizing you up.
I step back half a pace, guarding my grass.
My head hurts, can't move.
This hurts so much.
Injured, need to hide.
Can't move, need grass.
Headache, need to rest.
Injured, need a hole.
Need grass to heal.
Hide, don't be found.
Injured, need grass.
Need to heal.

lines.zh: 看这丰饶的土地，该吃点草了！
lines.en: Look at this fertile land, time to munch some grass!

lines.zh: 这片草地真香，让我饱餐一顿吧！
lines.en: Such tasty grass, let me feast!

lines.zh: 那边的植物太诱人了，我得去尝一尝！
lines.en: That plant looks so delicious, I must try it!

lines.zh: 这草好嫩，啃一口真不错！
lines.en: Such tender grass, perfect!

lines.zh: 我来啦，草地上美味等我呢！
lines.en: Here I come, delicious grass awaits!

lines.zh: 这片草地是我的，别抢我的食物！
lines.en: This is my grassland, don't steal my food!

lines.zh: 这些植物好甜，让我多吃些！
lines.en: These plants taste sweet, let me eat more!

lines.zh: 这么多美味，我能吃个够！
lines.en: So much delicious, I can eat my fill!

lines.zh: 别靠近，我是这片草地上唯一的食草者！
lines.en: Stay back, I'm the only herbivore here!

lines.zh: 这片草地是我的，谁也别想吃光！
lines.en: This is my grassland, none will eat it all!
Hey, you bumped into me, apologize!
Don't touch me, I'm busy!
Watch out, I'll use my head to crash into you!
You dare touch me, my head is hard!
Don't get close, be careful of my head!

lines.zh: 我的头角很硬，小心被撞！
lines.en: My head is hard, be careful not to get crashed!
Want to touch me? Try!
Watch out, I'll crash into you with my head!
Stay away, be careful not to get crashed!
Don't touch my head, it hurts!

lines.zh: 找个合适的对象，好繁殖！
lines.en: Find a mate to reproduce!

lines.zh: 找个合适的对象，繁衍后代！
lines.en: Find a mate to have offspring!

lines.zh: 找个合适的对象，开始繁殖！
lines.en: Find a mate to start reproducing!

lines.zh: 找个合适的对象，开始交配！
lines.en: Find a mate to mate!

lines.zh: 找个合适的对象，共同繁衍！
lines.en: Find a mate to co-reproduce!

lines.zh: 找个合适的对象，开始繁殖吧！
lines.en: Find a mate to start reproduction!

lines.zh: 找个合适的对象，开始繁衍！
lines.en: Find a mate to start reproducing!

lines.zh: 找个合适的对象，开始交配吧！
lines.en: Find a mate to mate!

lines.zh: 找个合适的对象，开始繁衍后代！
lines.en: Find a mate to have offspring!
I tap my skull gently against my kind.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的低鸣声，低头啃食地面的植物。
lines.en: Makes a soft hum and lowers its head to munch on the ground plants.

lines.zh: 转动头部寻找适合的植物，发出咂嘴声。
lines.en: Turns its head to find suitable plants, makes a chewing sound.

lines.zh: 突然抬头，用小脑袋轻撞附近的石头，发出轻响。
lines.en: Rises its head and lightly bumps the nearby stone, making a soft sound.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的呼噜声，享受植物的味道。
lines.en: Makes a soft snore, savoring the taste of the plant.

lines.zh: 轻声哼叫，寻找更多可食用的植物。
lines.en: Gives a soft hum, searching for more edible plants.

lines.zh: 咀嚼着植物，发出满意的咕噜声。
lines.en: Munches on the plant, making contented gurgling noises.

lines.zh: 转动脖子，寻找食物的来源。
lines.en: TURNS head to locate the source of food.

lines.zh: 小脑袋在地面上摩擦，发出轻微摩擦声。
lines.en: Rubs its small head on the ground, making a soft rubbing sound.

lines.zh: 低头啃食地上的叶子，发出咀嚼声。
lines.en: Lowers its head to munch on the leaves, making chewing sounds.

lines.zh: 嗅了嗅空气，发现新的食物目标。
lines.en: Sniffs the air, detects a new food target.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咆哮声，盯着潜在的目标。
lines.en: ROARS softly, locking eyes on a potential target.

lines.zh: 突然转向，用目光锁定新的目标。
lines.en: SHIFTS gaze to lock onto a new target.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的警告声，准备攻击。
lines.en: ISSUES a soft warning, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的吼声，警示周围的植物。
lines.en: ROARS lowly, warning the surrounding plants.

lines.zh: 发出轻声的嘶嘶声，表示警觉。
lines.en: EMITS a soft hiss, showing alertness.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的嘶鸣，表示警告。
lines.en: ISSUES a soft hiss, as a warning.

lines.zh: 发出低声的警告，准备攻击。
lines.en: EMITS a low warning, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 发出轻声的咆哮，锁定目标。
lines.en: ROARS softly, locking onto the target.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的嘶嘶声，警告入侵者。
lines.en: EMITS a soft hiss, warning the intruder.

lines.zh: 发出低声的嘶嘶声，表示警觉。
lines.en: ISSUES a low hiss, showing alertness.
Someone has stepped onto my meadow.
Head low, I aim in that direction.
A leaf rustled. It is them.
I catch a smell I do not know.

lines.zh: 盯着目标，发出轻微的低鸣声。
lines.en: Locks onto the target, makes a soft hum.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，发出低沉的咆哮声。
lines.en: ALLOWS its gaze to the target, ROARS softly.

lines.zh: 聚焦目标，发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: FOCUSES on the target, EMITS a soft hiss.

lines.zh: 盯着目标，发出低沉的吼声。
lines.en: Locks onto the target, ROARS lowly.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，发出轻微的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: ALLOWS its gaze to the target, EMITS a soft hiss.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的嘶嘶声，锁定目标。
lines.en: EMITS a soft hiss, locking onto the target.

lines.zh: 聚焦目标，发出低沉的咆哮声。
lines.en: FOCUSES on the target, ROARS softly.

lines.zh: 盯着目标，发出低沉的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Locks onto the target, EMITS a low hiss.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，发出轻微的低鸣声。
lines.en: ALLOWS its gaze to the target, makes a soft hum.

lines.zh: 发出轻微的嘶嘶声，表示瞄准。
lines.en: EMITS a soft hiss, indicating it's targeting.
Hind legs braced, ready to lunge.
I aim at its knee.
This patch of ground answers to me.
I wait for it to turn, then push.
Three paces. Perfect for a charge.
Headbutt! Crack!
Hard headbutt! Bang bang bang!
Head crunched! Clatter clatter!
Full force! Boom boom!
Head bump! Plop!
Forceful headbutt! Bang bang bang!
Head crash! Crack!
Headbutt! Thud!
Hard headbutt! Bang bang!
Head bump! Ding ding dong!
Head down and a shove, and dirt flies!
My hard skull drums with a thud!
Hit and run, no lingering!
Thirteen points of hurt. Feeling it?
My skull is hard, and the grass is tender.
I'm the territory guardian!

lines.zh: 嫩草坡归我，先来顶一头。
lines.en: The tender slope is mine; come butt heads first.
This is my home!
I protect my territory!

lines.zh: 我用头顶开蕨丛，宣布占下。
lines.en: I shove through the ferns with my crown and claim them.
Here I am, who dares me?

lines.zh: 我的厚头顶已经抵着篱笆了。
lines.en: My thick crown is already pressed to the fence.
I am the lord of this land!

lines.zh: 这里是我的地盘，别想闯进来！
lines.en: This is my domain, don't try to enter!
This forest clearing is claimed.
My head pokes out of the ferns.
These tender grasses are mine now.
The little tyrant has arrived.
I make my entrance at a trot.
First, a stone to polish my skull.
Tree shadows fall across my back.
I declare ownership by the shrubs.
Burned by fire, run!

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，头先着地。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land head-first.
Drowned, hurts.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，头盾嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, my dome ringing.
Arrow hit me!
Magic hurts, hide.
Hungry, need grass.
Lightning hit me, hide.
Void, over.
